propositions: When the completion verifier fails with insufficient evidence due to search budget exhaustion (not criterion refutation), the gate should auto-resume the verification instead of surfacing failure to the operator

Auto-resumption is qualified by the existing _insufficiency_only predicate: it triggers only when every unmet criterion carries the framework-derived evidence_sufficient:false marker and no unmet record represents genuine refutation

The resumption loop is bounded by verify.auto_resume_max (default 2; 0 disables) and by progress: a resumption dispatches only when the prior attempt strictly increased the cache-credited PASS count; zero progress stops early
Each auto-resumption attempt re-invokes verify_completion with identical arguments and pinned ref, allowing the verdict cache to seed credited PASSes and concentrate budget on remaining criteria

Per-attempt telemetry (attempt number, cache-credited count, remaining unmet) is recorded in the verdict sidecar and close output; failed closes after exhausting resumption attempts state the attempt count and reason
